snippet.title: RayStorm HD XBOX 360 gameplay
snippet.description: Raystom HD, Brings back so much memories. I used to love these shooters but at times , all these shooters from NEO-GEO to PS1 the enemies started to overwelm my vision. At times I was like where did that bullet come from. You really can not focus on the beatiful graphics or the surroundings. You have to focus on the dodging bullets. That is the name of these game Dodge bullets. From Raystorm to Raiden to Blazing Stars and Last Restort. I always love these games to see how far you can go with the graphics. NO , I didn't forget about aero fighters or aero assault. Lets check out the first 2 levels and boss fights. All gameplay is my own enjoy Subscribe. See you next time.  GOD BLESS.
